findings.summary: Dockerfile:7: this updates round 2's minor finding about restarts for nothing, which a8dd3b0 only partly fixes. I tested locally with buildx 0.39: with `provenance: false`, a fully cached rebuild gives the same manifest digest, so docs-only merges no longer restart the pod. But `COPY . .` still copies README.md, CLAUDE.md, board.toml, .claude/ and .github/ into the build, because .dockerignore leaves out only target, .git, .sdlc, deploy, argocd and docs. A merge that changes only one of those files misses the cache at `COPY . .` and runs cargo again. The final stage's `COPY --from=build` layer then gets new file mtimes and a new config timestamp, so the digest changes. The sequence: such a merge reaches main, 'Decide tags' (.github/workflows/ci.yaml:64) gives it :latest, Image Updater writes back the new digest, and the single Recreate pod (deploy/templates/board.yaml:29) is restarted for code that didn't change. Because SIGTERM is ignored (round 2's open minor), that is at least 30 s with no endpoint. Fix: add those paths to .dockerignore, or copy only Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and crates/.
